formalization_scope: local deduction over audited black boxes
notes: Successor to LATT-0005 answering the LREV-0009 findings. It restores a single general Ionel-Looijenga premise typed by genus, markings, codimension and cohomological level; carries the CLP Table 1 bound c(g) as a datum independent of n-1 and makes it select the endpoint route; splits the five critical endpoints into the three one-marking cases, the direct published-range case (4,10) and the repaired genus-five case (5,8); checks every endpoint record against the critical-line arithmetic; types smooth-proper purity separately from the purity tag and Kunneth separately from the finite graph invariants; and supplies non-collapse witnesses that isolate each arithmetic gate and show the Tate conclusion fails without purity.
